nodes.summary: Any two overpartitions of $0$ are equal.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the overpartition of zero

nodes.summary: For every partition $p$ of $n$, the set of overlined part sizes of the fully overlined overpartition of $p$ is the set of distinct parts of $p$.
nodes.title: Overlined sizes of the fully overlined overpartition

nodes.summary: For every partition $p$ of $n$, the underlying partition of the fully overlined overpartition of $p$ is $p$.
nodes.title: Underlying partition of the fully overlined overpartition

nodes.summary: For a partition $p$ of $n$, the fully overlined overpartition of $p$ is the overpartition of $n$ whose underlying partition is $p$ and whose set of overlined part sizes is the set of all distinct parts of $p$.
nodes.title: Fully overlined overpartition

nodes.summary: For every partition $p$ of $n$ and every natural number $a$, $a$ is overlined in the fully overlined overpartition of $p$ if and only if $a$ is a part of $p$.
nodes.title: Overlined sizes in the fully overlined overpartition

nodes.summary: For an overpartition $O$ of $n$ and a natural number $a$, $a$ is overlined in $O$ if and only if $a$ belongs to the set of overlined part sizes of $O$.
nodes.title: Characterization of overlined sizes

nodes.summary: If $a$ is overlined in an overpartition $O$ of $n$, then $a$ is a part of the underlying partition of $O$.
nodes.title: Overlined sizes are parts

nodes.summary: If $a$ is overlined in an overpartition $O$ of $n$, then $a > 0$.
nodes.title: Overlined sizes are positive

nodes.summary: A natural number $a$ is overlined in an overpartition $O$ of $n$ when $a$ belongs to the set of overlined part sizes of $O$.
nodes.title: Overlined part size

nodes.summary: For every partition $p$ of $n$ and every natural number $a$, $a$ is not overlined in the overpartition whose underlying partition is $p$ and whose set of overlined part sizes is empty.
nodes.title: No overlines in a plain partition

nodes.summary: For every partition $p$ of a natural number $n$, the overpartition of $n$ attached to $p$ (underlying partition $p$, no part size overlined) has an empty set of overlined part sizes.
nodes.title: The overpartition attached to a partition has no overlined sizes

nodes.summary: For every partition $p$ of a natural number $n$, the underlying partition of the overpartition of $n$ attached to $p$ (underlying partition $p$, no part size overlined) is $p$.
nodes.title: The underlying partition of the overpartition attached to a partition

nodes.summary: For a partition $p$ of a natural number $n$, the overpartition of $n$ attached to $p$ has underlying partition $p$ and no overlined part sizes.
nodes.title: The overpartition attached to a partition

nodes.summary: Every overpartition of $0$ has no overlined part sizes.
nodes.title: Overpartitions of zero have no overlined sizes

nodes.summary: An overpartition of a natural number $n$ consists of a partition $p$ of $n$ together with a finite set of overlined part sizes, each of which occurs as a part of $p$.
nodes.title: Overpartition

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
